_comment: WHINK-side permission classes for gateway tools, keyed by full WHINK tool name. Any gateway tool not listed here, or whose sanitised definition no longer matches defHash, is Class C (always needs a human). Compute defHash with scripts/tool-def-hash.ts after reviewing the tool. A class or annotation sent by the gateway is ignored. Social read tools (2d) are hashed against services/openclaw/upstreams/social/src/tools.ts; re-run scripts/tool-def-hash.ts against the live gateway if a hash ever mismatches (a mismatch only makes the tool Class C). Social write tools are deliberately absent: Class C by default.
